execution_rule: Signal at close of day t; enter at open of t+1; exit at close of t+5. Target R = ln(close_{t+5}/open_{t+1}); z = R/(sigma_20*sqrt(5)) with sigma from past 20 daily log returns at t only. Purge gap ≥ 5 trading days in walk-forward.
survivorship_note: Fixed liquid universe from available TrendLab symbols; point-in-time index membership not reconstructed.
agents_note: TrendLab rule agents (ema_trend, breakout, momentum, supertrend) are rule-based benchmarks, not PE predictors.
